content: .{@-पृष्टः@} .²1 one of the military profession, a soldier; <ab>cf.</ab> काण्डस्पृष्टः. .²2 the husband of a Vaiśya woman. .²3 an adopted son, any other than oneʼs own son. .²4 (as a term of reproach) a base-born fellow, one who is faithless to his family, caste, religion, profession <ab>&c.</ab> In <ls>Mv. 3</ls> Jāmadagnya is styled by शतानन्द as काण्डपृष्ठ. (स्वकुलं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा यो वै परकुलं व्रजेत् . तेन दुश्चरितेनासौ काण्डपृष्ठ इति स्मृतः ..).
